label: gonad
description: organ producing either sperm or ova.

label: motor neuron
description: neuron making synapse on an effector (muscle, gland).

label: nerve ring
description: the most extensive region of neuropil in the animal, consists of a large toroidal bundle of processes.

label: cuticle
description: a rigid external coating which is secreted by the hypodermis, seam and some transitional epithelial cells which covers the outer body, the major openings  into the body cavity from the exterior, and two large sensory bristles, the male spicules.  The cuticle of the spicules, the hook,  and of some portions of the spicule channels is especially rigid and is probably sclerotized.  Similar sclerotic features are occasionally noted in the ventral surface of the male tail fan.

label: coelomocyte
description: A free-floating spherical cell lying in the pseudocoelomic cavity of larvae and adult C. elegans which can endocytose many compounds, possibly for immune surveillance.  There are six coelomocytes in adult hermaphrodites, and they display prominent cytoplasmic inclusions and vacuoles.
